# JobHackAI

> Talk through questions for your target role with an AI interviewer. Get feedback on your answers and find something specific to improve before the real conversation.

Your free interview includes a feedback preview: one strength and one area to improve. A paid plan or pack unlocks the full report and transcript, plus more practice.

## Product

- [JobHackAI | Practice Your Next Interview Out Loud](https://jobhackai.io/index.md): Practice a live voice mock interview for your target role. Your first interview is free with a feedback preview. Continue with $17/week, $34/month, or five interviews for $39. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/)
- [Voice Mock Interview & Preparation Tools | JobHackAI Features](https://jobhackai.io/features.md): Choose your role, answer aloud, handle follow-up questions, and review feedback. See the free interview preview and paid full report in JobHackAI. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/features)

## Account and pricing

- [Pricing](https://app.jobhackai.io/pricing): current plans and billing terms.
- [Sign up](https://app.jobhackai.io/login?mode=signup): create an account to use the tools.

## Interview preparation and job search articles

- [JobHackAI Blog | Job Search Tips, Resume & LinkedIn Guides](https://jobhackai.io/blog.md): Actionable job search tips, resume optimization guides, LinkedIn strategies, and interview prep from the JobHackAI team. Published weekly. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog)
- [68.5 Days of Nothing: The Psychological Toll of the 2026 Response Gap | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/68-5-days-response-gap-job-search-burnout.md): Long hiring timelines can drain job seekers before interviews even begin. Learn how to protect momentum, improve ATS alignment, and prepare while you wait. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/68-5-days-response-gap-job-search-burnout)
- [The 7-Day Interview Prep Routine That Builds Real Confidence | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/7-day-interview-prep-routine.md): Stop cramming the night before. This structured 7-day interview prep routine builds the deep fluency that lets you answer any question naturally — not robotically — and walk in with genuine confidence. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/7-day-interview-prep-routine)
- [The ATS Optimization Playbook: Get Your Resume Past the Bots | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/ats-optimization-playbook.md): Most resumes are rejected by ATS before a human reads them. This step-by-step playbook shows you exactly how to optimize your resume for ATS filters without losing your voice. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/ats-optimization-playbook)
- [Behavioral Interview Anxiety: Why 85% of Job Seekers Feel Unprepared (And the Fix) | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/behavioral-interview-anxiety.md): 85% of job seekers feel unprepared for behavioral interviews. Learn the SAO framework and text-based practice method that closes the Experience Gap and beats anxiety. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/behavioral-interview-anxiety)
- [Below 1.0: How the New Leverage Gap Is Rewriting the Rules of Your Resume | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/below-1-0-leverage-gap-resume.md): The job market has tilted back toward employers. Learn why generic resumes get filtered out faster and how ATS-friendly resume optimization helps candidates adapt. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/below-1-0-leverage-gap-resume)
- [The Credibility Deficit: How We Lost Our Voice in the Age of Autocomplete | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/credibility-deficit-age-of-autocomplete.md): When AI writes everyone's resume, the polished version of you becomes a liability in the interview. Learn how to stand out by being unmistakably human. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/credibility-deficit-age-of-autocomplete)
- [How to Answer “Tell Me About Yourself” in an Interview | JobHackAI Blog](https://jobhackai.io/blog/how-to-answer-tell-me-about-yourself.md): Build an introduction around your current work, one relevant example and why this role fits. A practical guide to typed and spoken interview preparation. [HTML](https://jobhackai.io/blog/mock-interview-online)
